conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello? I applied for a personal loan last month, but nobody’s told me what’s happening with it.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Good afternoon, Sir. I’d be happy to check the status. Could you provide your application ID or full name?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s Priyansh Sharma. I don’t have any ID number… nobody gave me one!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No worries, I can search by name. One moment… It looks like your application is under review due to a pending CIBIL score update.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: CIBIL? What’s that? Nobody told me about this!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I apologize for the confusion. CIBIL is your credit score, and we’re waiting for the latest report. I’ll escalate this to expedite the process.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Okay… please do it fast. I need the money soon.
